scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun --bun tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && bun --bun tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.api:generate: uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py && bun run --cwd packages/api-client generate
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run api:check && bun run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: bun test apps/web/components/preview/*.test.ts apps/web/components/workspace/*.test.ts apps/web/components/study/*.test.ts packages/api-client/src/*.test.ts
